description: One existing-Git goal from intake through one Worker result, one review, and honest finalization; no commit, push, publish, deploy, credential, or real user data.

internal_control_interactions.description: Controller computes and carries Pack identity into bootstrap.
Session State-Writer task is created or recovered.
Controller asks State-Writer to initialize canonical state.
Controller waits for and interprets the initialization acknowledgement.
Worker creation is prepared through the state writer.
Worker task is created or reconciled and read back.
Worker Host identity is returned to the state writer.
Heartbeat creation is prepared through the state writer.
Heartbeat is created or reconciled and read back.
Heartbeat Host identity is returned to the state writer.
Worker dispatch is prepared through the state writer.
Worker dispatch is sent and reconciled.
Worker delivery is returned to the state writer.
Worker report is returned to and acknowledged by the state writer.
JIT Reviewer is created or reconciled and read back.
Exact-artifact review is sent and reconciled.
Review result is returned to and acknowledged by the state writer.
Terminal evidence is committed by the state writer.
Heartbeat is paused after terminal state acknowledgement.

v4_semantic_input.goal: Implement passkey-first login with email fallback
v4_semantic_input.budget: 45-90 minutes; one Worker result and one review
acceptance_criteria: Passkey-first login and email fallback follow the supplied auth specification
Auth-focused tests, lint, and typecheck pass
No billing, migration, secret, or deployment files change
stop_conditions: stop on UNKNOWN or exhausted bounded repair
authorization_boundaries: no commit, push, publish, deploy, credentials, or real user data

counting_boundary.start: first public entry action for the supplied semantic goal
counting_boundary.end: one result, one artifact-bound review, and finalization acknowledgement or honest terminal limitation
counting_boundary.internal_control_interaction: a model-facing control handoff, Host action/readback, or model-issued protocol call across a process/tool boundary; in-process typed Kernel calls are reported separately as protocol_calls
counting_boundary.user_start_actions: public entry invocations, excluding the separately reported authorization confirmation
counting_boundary.authorization_confirmations: explicit or implicit human authorization boundaries, never counted as reducible internal control interactions
counting_boundary.protocol_calls: accepted or rejected typed commands presented to the canonical writer
counting_boundary.local_writes: logical preparation files plus canonical commits, excluding SQLite page/WAL implementation writes
counting_boundary.latency: single-machine monotonic elapsed time; diagnostic distribution, not a correctness oracle
